question.text: In the PPM's Track Record section, historical performance of the fund over 6 months / 1 year / 3 years / 5 years is SPECIFICALLY applicable to:

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5 Box 9.1 Section VI lists the historical-track-record period '(applicable for Category III AIFs)' — 6m/1y/3y/5y. This aligns with liquid-fund performance norms; Cat I/II use IRR/MOIC/DPI/RVPI/TVPI which are drawdown-fund metrics. The Trap: Options A, B are Cat I/II which do not use horizon-based percentage returns. Option D is an invented sub-category. Note: Page 232 of the workbook lists the Category III track-record periods; page 156 provides general performance-reporting context.
